blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.
blocks.zh: 传播视频模型产生出惊人的片段,但它们无法可靠地使精确的公式,正确的图表,规则相符合的游戏或叙述同步到屏幕上的事件. 一个不同的路线正在出现: 写出代码的多模式代理来渲染出每个帧并合成每个声音. 我们引入了VibeVideo Bench, 用于评估代理 代码驱动的视频生成。 它的239个自成一体的英语和汉语任务分为12个类别,从数据故事和由音乐驱动的片段到课堂课和纸上解说;每个类别都要求一个在沙盒内以自生自灭的绳子运行的特工在一小时内交付一个有声音的完成的MP4. 评价是分级的和以证据为基础的:交付种类的程序检查,追踪到它们所执行的要求的约13k项特定任务的标题检查,以及每个任务定位的五个质量维度,由三个VLM法官小组进行判断,并以盲目的人类偏好加以验证. 在9个前沿代理系统和2,151个得分的推出中,基准远远没有解决:GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5明显领先,然而即使是最好的系统也未能满足约四分之一任务的核心要求. 影片的到来是否与质量一样重要, 评委们在系统排名上互相认同,并赞同人类的偏好,但在个人视频上却只是适度的.

Each panel is one frame of an unedited delivery from our evaluation, made by an off-the-shelf agent in its native harness inside a sandbox within one hour: rendered with three.js, Canvas, SVG or cairo, voiced with TTS, scored with synthesized music and sound effects, and muxed with ffmpeg. The 239 tasks span 12 categories, English and Chinese, and 8 s to 15 min of target runtime; each is graded by program checks, 54 task-specific rubric checks on average and five quality dimensions, judged by three audio-visual judge panels.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation has advanced rapidly through diffusion transformers [ 5 , 15 , 26 , 40 , 45 , 35 ] , and benchmarks such as VBench [ 21 , 48 ] and EvalCrafter [ 30 ] measure how plausible and prompt-aligned the generated clips look. Yet many of the videos people actually make—classroom lessons, paper explainers, data stories, product walkthroughs, assembly sequences, rhythm games—demand properties that pixel generators do not guarantee: exact text and numbers, rule-consistent state changes, multi-minute structure, sound aligned to events , and an artifact that can be revised. These are natural properties of programs . Humans already make such videos with Manim or Remotion, and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI [ 1 , 33 , 14 ] can now work autonomously for hours, driving a full toolchain—a renderer, a headless browser, a TTS engine, ffmpeg—on their own. Users have begun to ask agents for finished videos this way, which requires a multimodal agent that reads input assets, produces picture and sound through code, and inspects its own renders to correct them.
blocks.zh: 通过传播变压器[5,15,26,40,45,35],以及V Bench [21,48]和EvalCrrafter [30] 等基准,视频的生成迅速推进,衡量生成的剪辑看起来是否可信和迅速相通. 然而许多影片的制作者其实是:课堂课、纸质解释器、数据故事、产品走通、组装序列、节奏游戏、像素生成器不能保证的要求属性:准确的文字和数字、符合规则的状态变化、多分钟的结构、声音与事件一致,以及可修改的文物。 这些是程序的自然属性。 人类已经用Manim 或 Remotion 制作这样的视频, 诸如克洛德代码( Claude Code), Codex 和双子座CLI[ 1, 33, 14] 等编码代理现在可以自主工作数小时, 驾驶一个完整的工具链—— 一个渲染器, 一个无头浏览器, 一个 TTS 引擎, ffmpeg—— 在他们自己身上. 用户开始以这种方式向代理商询问已完成的视频,这需要一位多模式代理商读取输入资产,通过代码制作图片和声音,并检查自己的制作来纠正.

blocks.en: How good are agents at making videos? Existing evaluations do not answer this. Video-generation benchmarks score short, silent clips from generative models [ 21 , 30 , 18 ] . Code-to-visual benchmarks score single programs or static artifacts such as charts, web pages and SVGs [ 37 , 38 , 47 , 9 ] . Code-based lesson and paper-to-video systems [ 27 , 10 , 50 ] propose purpose-built, single-domain pipelines rather than testing general agents. Agentic benchmarks [ 24 , 32 , 43 ] verify textual or functional outcomes with unit tests, whereas a video is a perceptual, temporal and audio-visual outcome for which no unit test exists. Video therefore tests what text-only agentic benchmarks cannot: whether an agent can check its own output across picture, sound and time.
blocks.zh: 代理商对制作视频有多好? 现有的评价不能回答这个问题。 视频生成基准从基因模型中得分短而无声的片段[21,30,18]. 代码对视基准得分单程序或静态文物,如图表,网页和SVG[37,38,47,9]. 基于代码的教程和从纸到视频的系统[27,10,50]提出专用的,单域的管线,而不是测试一般剂. 代理基准[24,32,43]通过单位测试来验证文字或功能结果,而视频是一种视觉,时间和视听结果,没有单位测试. 因此,视频检验的是仅文本代理基准不能做到的:一个代理是否能够在图片、声音和时间中检查自己的产出。

blocks.en: We present VibeVideoBench (Figs. 1 and 2 ), a benchmark that evaluates multimodal agents end to end on code-driven video generation : given a specification and optional input assets, an agent must deliver a finished MP4, built entirely with code, inside a sandbox within one hour, with narration, music and sound effects as each task’s audio policy specifies. Its 239 tasks span 12 categories, from brand promos and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers, in English and Chinese. Building it required solving two problems.
blocks.zh: 我们提出VibeVideo Bench(图1和图2), 用以评价多模式代理商的基准以代码驱动的视频生成结束:鉴于规格和可选的输入资产, 代理商必须在一个小时内在沙盒内交付一个完全用代码构建的MP4, 并按每项任务的音频政策规定, 它的239项任务涉及12个类别,从品牌花瓶和由音乐驱动的片段到课堂课和纸上讲解,用英语和中文讲解. 它的建设需要解决两个问题。

blocks.en: Tasks must be realistic yet checkable. We build tasks from four sources—real user requests to code-video tools, real videos (seeded from their dense captions), real asset packs such as 3D scans and game levels, and lecture notes and research papers—and turn each into a self-contained specification that fixes facts, identities, stages, timing and the audio policy while preserving creative freedom.
blocks.zh: 任务必须是现实的,但可以核对。 我们从四个来源来构建任务——真实用户对代码视频工具的要求,真实视频(来自其密集的字幕),真实资产包如3D扫描和游戏关卡,以及讲座笔记和研究论文——并将每个内容变成一个自成一体的规格,既可以固定事实,身份,阶段,时间和音频政策,同时又可以保留创作自由.

blocks.en: Evaluation must rest on evidence in the video. Evaluation has three layers with different executors. Program checks (L1) automatically verify the delivery spec—resolution, frame rate, duration, audible sound, source project. Rubric checks (L2; about 13k in total) are each traced to the requirement they enforce, separate process shown from result claimed , and are tagged by modality. Quality scores (L3) rate five dimensions—visual quality, aesthetics, content logic, timing and audio—each anchored at 1, 3 and 5 by descriptions written for the task. L2 and L3 are judged by VLM judges in three independent panels: two watch the full video with sound, and the third routes visual checks to a vision model and audio checks to an audio-capable model, so audio checks never reach a judge that cannot hear. We validate the judges against blind pairwise human preferences.
blocks.zh: 评估必须依赖于视频中的证据。 评价有三个层次,有不同的执行者。 程序检查(L1)自动验证交付光谱——分辨率,帧率,持续时间,可发音,源项目. Rubric check(L2;共计约13k)分别追踪到它们执行的要求,与声称的结果分开显示过程,并按方式作标记。 质量分数(L3)按五个维度——视觉质量、美学、内容逻辑、时间和音频——进行评分,每个分数按1、3和5计分,并按任务说明。 L2和L3由VLM法官在三个独立小组中进行判断:两个用声音观看完整的视频,第三个路线是视觉检查到一个视觉模型,音频检查到一个有声能的模型,所以音频检查永远不能到达一个听不见的法官. 我们证明法官们不偏爱盲目的双胞胎。

blocks.en: To simulate real user settings, we evaluate agents as they are deployed : each model runs fully autonomously in its vendor’s native harness at maximum effort, with no follow-up turns and all tool permissions pre-approved, in identical containers with the same one-hour budget. Users adopt the model and its harness as one system, so we evaluate complete agent systems rather than separating model from harness. Nine frontier systems from six labs yield 2,151 scored rollouts.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟真正的用户环境,我们评价部署时的代理人:每个模型在供应商的自带设备中尽最大努力完全自动运行,没有后续转接,所有工具的许可都事先得到批准,在相同的容器中使用同一个一小时的预算。 用户将模型及其被利用作为一个系统,所以我们评价完整的代理系统,而不是将模型与被利用分开。 6个实验室的9个前沿系统 得到2 151个分数

blocks.en: Findings. The benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as how good it is: counting missing videos as zero reorders the ranking, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders that started too late, ran too slowly or never started. The three judge panels agree with each other and with blind human preferences on how systems rank, but only moderately on individual videos (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 发现 基准还远远没有解决:GPT-6 Astra和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5明显领先,然而即使是最好的系统也未能满足约四分之一任务的核心要求. 将缺失的视频计为零重排排名, 四分之三的已丢失的视频是最终的, 三个法官小组彼此同意,在制度如何排列问题上,人类盲目偏好,但在个人视频上却略有偏好(第5节)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • VibeVideoBench , to our knowledge the first benchmark of general multimodal agents on open-domain code-driven video generation with audio: 239 tasks in 12 categories (English and Chinese), about 13k task-specific rubric checks, each traced to the requirement it enforces, input assets and a reproducible sandbox, scoring composed multi-minute videos made by general agents rather than generated clips or one purpose-built pipeline (§ 3 , Tab. 1 ). • A hierarchical, evidence-based evaluation protocol that pairs program checks with modality-routed VLM judge panels, handles non-delivery explicitly, and is validated by agreement across three independent judge panels and with blind human preferences (§ 4 ). • A large-scale empirical study of nine frontier agent systems (2,151 scored rollouts, 6.5k video judgments), with a run-by-run analysis of all 224 failed deliveries, a trajectory-level analysis of how agents make videos, and a blind human preference study on all 239 tasks (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:VibeVideo Bench, 据我们所知,关于开放域码驱动视频生成的一般多模式代理的第一个基准:239项任务,分为12个类别(英语和中文),约13k项任务专项检查,每个类别追踪到其执行的要求、输入资产和可复制的沙盒,评分由一般代理制作的多分钟录像而不是生成短片或一个专用管道(第3节,Tab. 1)。 分级、循证评价协议,将程序检查与模式引导的VLM法官小组挂钩,明确处理不交付,并由三个独立法官小组以盲人偏好的方式通过协议进行验证(第4节)。 对9个前沿代理系统进行大规模实证研究(2,151分出局,6.5克视频判决),对所有224次未交付情况进行逐次分析,对代理制作视频的方式进行轨迹分析,对所有239项任务进行盲人偏好研究(第5节)。

blocks.en: VibeVideoBench , to our knowledge the first benchmark of general multimodal agents on open-domain code-driven video generation with audio: 239 tasks in 12 categories (English and Chinese), about 13k task-specific rubric checks, each traced to the requirement it enforces, input assets and a reproducible sandbox, scoring composed multi-minute videos made by general agents rather than generated clips or one purpose-built pipeline (§ 3 , Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: VibeVideo Bench, 据我们所知,关于开放域码驱动视频生成的一般多模式代理的第一个基准:239项任务,分为12个类别(英文和中文),约13k项任务特定分号检查,每个分号追踪到它执行的要求,输入资产和可复制的沙盒,评分由一般代理制作的由多分钟组成的视频,而不是生成剪辑或一个专用管道(第3节,Tab. 1)。

blocks.en: A hierarchical, evidence-based evaluation protocol that pairs program checks with modality-routed VLM judge panels, handles non-delivery explicitly, and is validated by agreement across three independent judge panels and with blind human preferences (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 基于证据的分级评价协议,将程序检查与按模式排列的VLM法官小组相结合,明确处理不交付问题,并在三个独立法官小组之间协议验证,并带有盲目的人类偏好(第4节)。

blocks.en: A large-scale empirical study of nine frontier agent systems (2,151 scored rollouts, 6.5k video judgments), with a run-by-run analysis of all 224 failed deliveries, a trajectory-level analysis of how agents make videos, and a blind human preference study on all 239 tasks (§ 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video generation: the pixel paradigm. Diffusion-transformer generators [ 5 , 15 , 28 , 40 ] synthesize pixels directly from text or images and are evaluated by dimension-wise suites [ 21 , 48 , 30 ] , learned scorers [ 18 ] , physics probes [ 31 , 3 ] and arenas [ 22 ] ; VideoArgus [ 46 ] , closest in spirit to our rubric checks, builds sample-specific rubrics before seeing outputs. Story-video systems [ 29 , 42 ] add an LLM planner, but a generative model still paints the pixels. We study a different paradigm, in which an agent produces a video by writing programs that drive renderers, TTS and ffmpeg, so that content is exact, editable, and controllable in length and sound. Evaluation that asks whether a few seconds of mostly silent footage look plausible does not transfer to it.

blocks.en: Code as a visual medium: the program paradigm. Programs are an editable, verifiable visual representation of charts, web pages, SVG and 3D scenes [ 37 , 38 , 9 , 16 ] ; ArtifactsBench [ 47 ] grades interactive artifacts from screenshots with checklist-guided MLLM judges. For video, TheoremExplainAgent [ 27 ] , Code2Video [ 10 ] , VisualEDU [ 8 ] and ManimAgent [ 23 ] generate educational Manim videos, Paper2Video [ 50 ] turns research papers into narrated slide talks, and Code2Video-Compass [ 11 ] and an industry benchmark [ 19 ] score short silent clips written in one framework. None of these is agentic in our sense: each video comes from a fixed pipeline built around one renderer or genre, or from a single model call, rather than from an agent that chooses its own tools and renders, inspects and revises its own video.
blocks.zh: 代码为视觉介质:程序范式. 节目是对图表,网页,SVG和3D场景[37,38,9,16]的可编辑,可核查的可视化表现; Artifacts Bench[47] 分级互动出品,取自有清单制导的MLLM评委的截图. 对于视频,定理解释代理 [27],代码2Video [10],VisualEDU [8] 和ManimAgent [23] 生成教育性的Manim视频,Papet2Video [50] 将研究论文变成叙事的幻灯片谈话,代码2Video-Compass [11]和行业基准 [19] 得分在一个框架中所写的短篇无声短片. 这些都不是我们意义上的代理:每个视频都来自围绕一个渲染器或流派建造的固定管线,或者来自一个单一的模型调用,而不是来自一个自己选择工具并制作,检查和修改自己的视频的代理.

blocks.en: Agent benchmarks. Software and computer-use agents are measured by SWE-bench [ 24 ] , Terminal-Bench [ 32 ] , OSWorld [ 43 ] and PaperBench [ 39 ] , and GDPval [ 34 ] grades occupational deliverables by expert comparison. These verify text, files or functional behavior, whereas a video is a perceptual, temporal and audio-visual outcome for which no unit test exists. AgenticVBench [ 6 ] also runs general agents in vendor harnesses, but on post-production of given footage; in our setting every frame and sound must be constructed by code. Tab. 1 contrasts VibeVideoBench with prior work on who makes the video, what is asked, what is delivered and how it is graded.
blocks.zh: 特工基准。 软件和计算机使用剂通过SWE-bench [24],Terminal-Bench [32],OSWorld [43]和Paper Bench [39],以及GDP[34]级职业可交付品进行专家比较来衡量. 这些可以验证文本、文件或功能行为,而视频是一种视觉、时间和视听结果,没有单位测试。 AgenticV Bench [6] 也运行一般代理商在销售机上,但在特定镜头制作后运行;在我们设定中,每个帧和声音都必须用代码来构建. Tab. 1 对比了 VibeVideo Bench 与之前关于谁制作视频的工作,询问什么,交付什么以及如何分级.

blocks.en: Judges, rubrics and human preference. LLM and multimodal judges [ 49 , 25 , 7 ] exhibit position and self-preference biases [ 41 ] ; rubric decomposition improves reliability in non-verifiable domains [ 2 , 17 ] , and pairwise human preference with Bradley–Terry aggregation [ 4 , 12 ] is the standard validation. Omni models can see and hear [ 44 ] , but audio-visual benchmarks show they remain weak at fine temporal alignment [ 13 , 20 ] . We therefore route checks by modality, require timestamped evidence, use three panels from different model families, and measure where they fail.
blocks.zh: 法官、人物和人类偏好 LLM和多式裁判 [49, 25, 7] 展出位置和自我偏好 [41]; rumic分解提高了不可核查域的可靠性 [2, 17], 与 Bradley – Terry 聚合 [4, 12] 的对等人类偏好是标准验证. Omni模型可以看见和听到[44],但视听基准显示它们在精细的时间比对[13,20]时仍然很弱. 因此,我们按方式进行路线检查,需要时间标记的证据,使用来自不同模范家庭的三个面板,并衡量它们失败之处。

blocks.zh: 3 维贝维多奔驰

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of VibeVideoBench. (a) Requests from four kinds of real-world sources are drafted under a shared contract, given the assets they need (searched for or synthesized by an LLM), and curated by humans, yielding a benchmark that is diverse in content, form, length and sound. (b) Each task gets a three-level rubric traced to its prompt and its input assets; L2 checks quote their basis and carry modality tags; rubrics go through rounds of model QC and human review until no confirmed finding remains. (c) Agents run in native harnesses in identical one-hour sandboxes; programs check L1, and three VLM judge panels—one routing each check by modality—score L2 and L3.
blocks.zh: 图2 维贝维多·本奇概况. (a) 四种现实世界来源的请求是根据共同合同起草的,考虑到它们需要的资产(由LLM搜索或合成),并由人类管理,从而得出一个内容、形式、长度和声音各不相同的基准。 (b) 每项任务都有一个可追溯到其即时和输入资产的三级标题;L2检查引用其依据并带有模式标记;分批进行模式QC和人文审查,直到没有确认的发现遗迹为止。 (c) 使用土生土长带运行的代理人用相同的一小时沙盒;程序检查L1和3个VLM法官面板——每个检查方式1个路径——分数L2和L3。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务拟定

blocks.en: A task τ = ( p , 𝒜 , d , a , c ) \tau=(p,\mathcal{A},d,a,c) consists of a natural-language specification p p , an optional read-only asset package 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (data, fonts, sprites, 3D scans, audio), a machine-readable delivery spec d d (resolution, frame rate, duration range [ t min , t max ] [t_{\min},t_{\max}] , optional exact frame count), an audio policy a a that marks each of four channels—narration, music, sound effects, ambience—as required , optional or not used , and an explicit creative-freedom statement c c . An agent receives ( p , 𝒜 , d , a , c ) (p,\mathcal{A},d,a,c) in a fresh container and must deliver a video v v , an editable source project and a timing sheet before the deadline. There is no ground-truth video : a deliverable is judged only against the frozen specification, and any rendering stack is allowed. Agents may not call image- or video-generation models; the only generative service provided is a TTS command-line tool backed by Qwen3-TTS-Flash [ 36 ] .

blocks.en: 3.2 Task construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 任务构建

blocks.en: Fig. 2 a shows the pipeline. Sources. Tasks start from four kinds of real-world sources: requests people wrote for code-based video tools (what people ask for), dense captions of real videos (what people actually make), real asset packs such as 3D scans, archival records and game sprites, and lecture notes and research papers. Specification contract. Real requests are rarely self-contained, so a source only seeds a task: LLM drafters with cross-review expand and rewrite it under a shared contract that fixes every fact, number and object identity the video depends on, divides it into stages with dwell times and states a four-channel audio policy, while protecting creative freedom; missing assets are searched for or synthesized. What the contract fixes can be checked, and what it leaves open measures the agent’s own design. Human curation. Humans select checkable tasks over open briefs, rewrite each into a self-contained prompt without authoring traces, verify its facts and remove duplicates across sources. The result is 239 tasks in 12 categories and 43 subcategories, from 8 s to 15 min, with narration, music, effects and ambience, with or without input assets (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 图2 a显示管道。 来源. 任务起源于四种现实世界的来源:要求人们为基于代码的视频工具(人们要求的)而写作,真实视频的密集字幕(人们实际制作的),3D扫描等真实资产包,档案记录和游戏图案,以及讲座说明和研究论文. 规格合同。 真正的请求很少是自成一体的,所以一个来源只能种子一个任务: LLM 起草器带有交叉评审的扩展并重写在共享合同下,该共享合同将视频所依赖的每一个事实,数字和对象身份固定下来,将其分出与居住时间相接的阶段,并声明一个四道音频政策,同时保护创作自由;缺失的资产被搜索或合成. 合同的修饰可以检查什么,以及它留下什么内容可以检查代理商自己的设计。 人间治道. 人类在开口简报上选择可核查的任务,将每个任务重写成一个自成一体的不写出痕迹的提示,验证其事实并去除不同来源的重复. 结果是12个类别和43个分类别的任务239项,从8 s到15 min,有叙述,音乐,效果和氛围,有无输入资产(图3.

blocks.zh: 3.3 统计

blocks.en: 3.4 Rubrics
blocks.zh: 3.4 润滑油

blocks.en: Fig. 2 b shows how rubrics are built. Every check traces to the final prompt (its requirements, delivery spec d d and audio policy a a ) and to the input assets. Each task is evaluated at three levels: L1 program checks , derived from d d and a a and decided by code; L2 task checks , atomic pass/fail checks that each quote the requirement they enforce as their basis, are marked core or detail, require the process to be shown rather than a result to be claimed, and carry a tag for the modality needed to decide them; and L3 quality , five 1–5 dimensions—visual quality (VQ), visual aesthetics (VA), content logic (CL), timing and motion (TM), and audio quality and A/V sync (AQ)—with anchors written per task. Rubrics go through rounds of model review, which flags over-strict, missing or undecidable checks, and human verification, until no flag holds; since judges never see the input assets, each check states the correct content itself. The final set has 1,449 L1 checks, 12,985 L2 checks (about 54 per task) and 1,195 L3 rubrics.
blocks.zh: 图2b显示了卢布的构造方式. 每一次检查都追踪到最后的提示(其要求、交付的 spec d 和音频策略 a )和输入资产。 每项任务在三个级别上进行评估:L1程序检查,由d和一个a产生,并由代码决定;L2任务检查,原子通过/失败检查,每个任务引用它们执行的要求作为其基础,是标记的核心或细节,要求显示进程而非要求的结果,并带有决定它们所需的方式的标记;L3质量,5个1至5个维度——视觉质量(VQ),视觉美学(VA),内容逻辑(CL),时间和运动(TM),音频质量和A/V同步(AQ),每个任务都有主播. Rubrics经过了几轮模式审查,这些审查标出超限、缺失或不可辨认的检查,以及人文核查,直到没有标出旗帜;由于法官从未看到输入资产,因此每个检查都说明正确的内容本身。 最后一套有1,449个L1支票,12,985个L2支票(约每任务54个)和1,195个L3卢克.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4. 评价议定书

blocks.en: Rollout. Every rollout runs in a fresh Docker sandbox with a common rendering toolchain ( e.g . , Python, Node, a headless browser, ffmpeg) and the TTS tool of § 3 , under a one-hour wall-clock budget. All model traffic is logged, so every trajectory, token and tool call is recorded, and each (system, task) has exactly one scored run. Details are in App. C .
blocks.zh: 推出。 每次推出都运行在一个新鲜的多克沙盒中,带有一个常见的渲染工具链(如:Python,Node,一个无头浏览器,ffmpeg)和§ 3的TTS工具,在1小时的墙钟预算下. 所有的模型流量都被记录下来,所以每个轨迹,信使和工具调用都被记录下来,每个(系统,任务)都有一个准确的得分跑. 详情见App.C.

blocks.en: L1: delivery and program checks. L1 is decided by programs alone; no model is involved. A run delivers if it leaves an MP4 that decodes and can be judged; the delivery rate is the share of tasks with such a video. Each delivery is then measured (ffprobe, a full decode, audio levels, VAD and Whisper language ID) and checked by code against the task’s machine-readable delivery spec d d and audio policy a a : every task checks container and decodability, resolution, frame rate ( ± \pm 0.01) and duration within [ t min − 0.5 , t max + 0.5 ] [t_{\min}{-}0.5,t_{\max}{+}0.5] s. The 205 core tasks add a delivered source project, an exact frame count where d d requires it (54 tasks) and an audible audio stream (peak > − 50 >{-}50 dBFS) where a a marks a channel as required (98 tasks under a strict parse). Lessons and papers, which all require narration, add an audible audio stream, narration coverage (VAD), narration language (ASR) and the absence of long black or frozen stretches. This gives 1,449 checks per system (1,177 core, 272 lesson and paper). Spec compliance is the share of tasks whose run passes all applicable checks; a non-delivery fails them all. (The rollout collector also runs a lighter container-level check at collection time, App. C ; we use it only in the behavior analysis of § 5.3 .)
blocks.zh: L1: 交付与程序检查. L1由程序单独决定;没有模型参与. 一个运行如果留下一个解码和可被判断的MP4,就会交付;交付率是使用这种视频的任务份额. 每一次交付随后被测量(ffprobe、全解码、音频级别、VAD和Whisper 语言ID),并以代码与任务机器可读的交付 spec d 和音频策略检查 a :每个任务检查容器和可解码性、分辨率、帧率(±\pm 0.01)以及[t min-0.5,t max- 0.5] s 内的持续时间。 205个核心任务增加了一个已交付的源项目,一个精确的dd要求的帧数(54个任务)和一个可听取的音频流(峰 > −50 >{-}50个dBFS),其中根据需要有一个道标(严格剖析下的98个任务). 教训和论文都需要叙述,它们都增加了一个可发声的音频流,叙述覆盖(VAD),叙述语言(ASR)以及没有长长的黑色或被冰冻的拉伸. 这使每个系统检查1 449次(1 177次核心检查、272次课和纸张检查)。 光谱遵守是任务的一部分,这些任务通过所有适用的检查;不交付则全部失败。 (推出收集器在收集时间也进行更轻的容器级别检查,App.C;我们仅在第5.3节的行为分析中使用.

L1 : playable videos (of 239) and spec compliance (% of tasks passing every program check). blocks.en: L2: rubric checks. For each check a judge returns pass, fail, unknown or n/a, with timestamped evidence. Judges score the 12,985 L2 checks (§ 3.4 ), and we report two metrics. L2 pass pools checks: it is # ​ pass / ( # ​ pass + # ​ fail ) \#\text{pass}/(\#\text{pass}{+}\#\text{fail}) , with unknown and n/a excluded. L2 strict (strict task success) is decided per run: a run succeeds if none of its core checks fails and at least one passes; unknown and n/a do not count against it, and a non-delivery fails. For example, the Super Mario level run (CG01) has 59 checks; a video in which Mario does not grow after touching the mushroom fails the core check “growth is discernible after contact”, so the run fails L2 strict even if the other 58 pass (L2 pass 98%); strict success is thus far more discriminative.
blocks.zh: L2:卢克支票. 每一次检查都有一名法官返回通行证、故障、未知或不详,并附有时间戳的证据。 法官评分为12 985 L2(第3.4节),我们报告两个衡量标准。 L2通过池检查:是#通过 / (#通过 + #失败) QQtext{pass}/ (XQtext{pass{text{fail}),未知和n/a除外. L2严格(严格任务成功)由每跑决定:如果其核心检查无一失败,至少一次通过;未知和n/a不计入,不交付则成功. 例如,超级马里奥级运行(CG01)有59个检查;在一段视频中,马里奥在触摸蘑菇失败后不会生长出"接触后会发现增长"核心检查,因此运行失败L2严格,即使其他58个通过(L2通过98%);迄今为止,严格的成功更具有歧视性.

blocks.en: L3: quality. The judge scores each of the five dimensions from 1 to 5 against the task’s own anchors, with reasons, strengths and defects; a dimension the judge cannot assess is left unknown and excluded. For CG01, timing and motion (TM) asks whether continuous motion, landings and state changes can be followed with enough time to see key dangers and successes; it scores 1 if key processes are hard to track, 3 if they can be tracked but transitions or holds are awkward, and 5 if key changes are clear and motion serves the task. The overall score is the mean of the five dimensions; it is not a weighted total of L1–L3, which we keep separate.
blocks.zh: L3:质量. 法官将五个维度中的每个从1到5按任务本身的起锚进行评分,有其原因、长处和缺陷;法官无法评估的维度被置之不理并排除在外。 对于CG01,时间和运动(TM)询问是否可以在足够时间内跟踪持续运动,着陆和状态变化,以看到关键的危险和成功;如果关键过程难以跟踪,则它得分为一;如果能够跟踪,但过渡或搁置是尴尬的,则得分为三;如果关键变化是清楚的,运动为任务服务,则得分为五. 总体分数是五个维度的平均值;不是我们分开的L1-L3的加权总分.

blocks.en: Delivered-only and no video = 0 =0 . Our primary display reports the delivery rate next to delivered-only L2 and L3 scores, which isolate the quality of what was delivered. We also report every metric with no video = 0 =0 : a non-delivery scores zero on every dimension and fails every check, so reliability and quality combine into one number.
blocks.zh: 仅交付且无视频=0=0. 我们的初等显示报告交付率旁边只有交付的L2和L3分数,这隔离了交付的质量. 我们还报告每个没有视频的度量值=0=0:每个维度的不交付分数为0并失败了每个检查,因此可靠性和质量结合为一个数字.

blocks.en:
Judge panels. Each delivered video is judged independently by three panels, each given the exact task prompt and the rubric but never the system identity. Judges are told that on-screen or narrated self-declarations are not evidence, and that unsampled instants cannot be asserted. J1 (Gemini 4 Argon) and J2 (Gemini 3.8 Flash) watch the full MP4 with sound (4 fps up to 150 s, adaptively lower for longer videos) and judge everything. J3 splits by modality following the check tags: GPT-5.6 Sol judges visual checks and VQ/VA/CL/TM from 24–300 sampled frames (up to 1280 px), and Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash judges audio and audio-visual checks and AQ from a full-length proxy with the original audio. Audio observations are passed to the vision judge as reference.
All three panels contain evaluated models (J1, J2 and J3’s vision judge); J3 shares no family with J1/J2. Each panel’s metrics are computed separately and then averaged; scores are never mixed across panels within a metric ( 3 × 2,151 3\times 2{,}151 run results). Tab. 2 reports the mean over the three panels; per-panel results are in App. E .
blocks.zh:
法官小组。 每个传送的视频由三个面板独立判断,每个面板给出准确的任务即时和标题,但从未给出系统身份. 法官被告知,屏幕上或自述的自我声明不是证据,不能断言没有样本的瞬间. J1 (Gemini 4 Argon)和J2(Gemini 3.8 Flash)用声音观看全MP4 (4 fps up to 150 s,可适应地更低以用于更长的视频),并判断一切. J3在检查标记后按方式分出: GPT-5.6 由24-300个抽样帧(最高为1280个px)的Sol法官视觉检查和VQ/VA/CL/TM,由Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash法官视听检查和AQ从带有原始音频的全长代理. 音频观察会传递给视觉裁判作为参考.
所有三个小组都包含评估模型(J1,J2和J3的视觉裁判);J3与J1/J2没有共同的家庭. 每个小组的衡量标准分别计算,然后是平均值;各小组的得分从不在一个衡量标准内混合(3×2,151 3\times 2{,}151) 。 附录2报告了三个小组的平均值;每个小组的结果载于附录E。

blocks.en: Human preference. To validate the judges we ran a blind pairwise study on all 239 tasks. Five annotators each saw the full prompt and two synchronized players with videos of two systems on the same task, both playable, and chose A , B , tie or both bad by overall quality and adherence ( N votes, N decisive). Human preference therefore measures the quality of delivered videos, not delivery. We fit Bradley–Terry strengths [ 4 ] on decisive votes (Elo scale, geometric mean 1000) with 2,000-sample bootstrap CIs and measure system-level rank correlation and pair-level agreement with each panel.
blocks.zh: 人类偏好。 为了验证法官们,我们对所有239项任务进行了盲目的对等研究。 五名注释员每人看到两个系统的全速和同步的玩家在同一个任务上都有视频,两者都可以播放,并选择了A,B,平分或两者均因整体质量和遵守而差(N票,N决定性). 因此,人类偏好衡量传送视频的质量,而不是传送。 Bradley – Terry 的优势在决定性的票数(Elo scale,几何平均值为1000)上配有2,000-sample sample spoint crips,并测量系统级别级别的相关性和与每个面板的对等级别协议.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: Systems. We evaluate nine agent systems from six labs, each in its native harness at the highest available reasoning effort and run fully autonomously, with no follow-up turns and all tool permissions pre-approved (Tab. 2 ): GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol (Codex CLI), Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (Claude Code), Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash (Antigravity CLI), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, version 1017 (DSH), Kimi K3 (Kimi Code) and GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode). Agents receive one fixed instruction (“read ENVIRONMENT.md and prompt.txt and complete the task autonomously before the deadline”). Every multimodal agent system ran all 239 tasks (2,151 rollouts).
blocks.zh: 系统 我们从6个实验室对9个代理系统进行评估,每个系统在现有的最大推理努力下在本地使用,并完全自主地运行,没有后续转弯,所有工具许可都事先得到批准(第2段):GPT-6 Astra和GPT-5.6 Sol(Codex CLI)、Claude Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5.5(Claude Code)、双子座4 Argon和双子座3.8 Flash(Antigravity CLI)、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,版本1017(DSH)、Kimi K3(Kimi Code)和GLM-5.3-Flash(ZCode)。 代理人收到一份固定指示(“读取Environment.md和eauly.txt,并在最后期限之前自动完成任务”)。 每个多式联运代理系统都执行全部239项任务(2,151个启动)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Main results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Finding 1. The benchmark is far from solved, and GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly.
blocks.zh: 查找 1. 基准远未解决,GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5明显领先。

blocks.en: The left half of Tab. 2 describes what systems deliver. L1: Opus is the only system to deliver all 239 videos and passes every program check on 99.6% of tasks; at the other end GLM-5.3-Flash delivers 179 videos and complies with the specification on 66.9%. L2: on delivered videos, item-level pass rates are close to the ceiling (80.5–97.3%), so single checks rarely fail; what fails is getting all of them right on one task (below). L3: Astra (4.13) and Opus (4.07) lead across the board: they hold the top two overall scores on delivered videos and the top two places on every quality dimension except audio (AQ), where Gemini 4 Argon is second; Gemini 3.8 Flash trails (3.47). Human: blind pairwise preferences between two playable videos confirm this order: Astra (Elo 1242) and Opus (1203) lead, and the human ranking matches delivered L3 almost exactly (Spearman ρ = 0.98 \rho{=}0.98 ; only the last two places swap).
blocks.zh: Tab. 2的左半部分描述了系统能提供什么. L1:Opus是唯一一个发送所有239个视频的系统,并且通过99.6%的任务的每个程序检查;另一端是GLM-5.3-Flash发送了179个视频,并且遵守66.9%的规格. L2:在传送的视频中,项目级的通过率接近上限(80.5-97.3%),因此单次检查很少失败;失败的是让全部完成一项任务(以下). L3:Astra (4.13)和Opus (4.07) 领先全局:他们在交付的视频上占据了总分前2名,在每个质量维度上占据了前2名,但音频(AQ)除外,双子座4 Argon排行第二;双子座3.8 Flash出道(3.47). 人:两个可播放视频之间盲目对等偏好证实了这个顺序:Astra (Elo 1242)和Opus (1203) 领跑,而人排赛几乎准确地交付了L3(Spearman $ = 0.98\rho = 0.98;只有后两地互换).

blocks.en: Finding 2. Delivery reliability is a second axis, separate from quality.
blocks.zh: 查找 2. 交付可靠性是第二个轴线,与质量分开。

blocks.en: The right half of Tab. 2 counts a missing video as a failure, and this largely changes both scores and ranks. Astra and Opus deliver almost every video and stay on top, whereas Gemini 4 Argon, which delivers only 77% of its videos, falls from 4th to 7th. L2 strict success requires every core check of a task to hold, so it spreads systems from 26.6% to 76.3%: even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Reliability also has quieter forms: 48 of the 213 playable videos of GPT-5.6 Sol have no audio track, which gives it the lowest AQ on delivered videos (3.71); see App. E for details.
blocks.zh: 塔布的右半边 2将缺失的视频算作失败,这在很大程度上改变了分数和排名. Astra和Opus提供几乎每段视频并停留在顶上,而只提供77%视频的双子座4Argon则从第4位跌至第7位. L2严格成功要求每个任务的核心检查都要坚持,因此它将系统从26.6%扩展至76.3%:即使是最好的系统也未能满足约四分之一任务的核心要求. 可靠性也有更安静的形式:GPT-5.6的213个可播放视频中有48个Sol没有音频音轨,这使得它在交付视频(3.71)上的AQ最低;参见App. E 详细情况。

blocks.en: 5.2 Why videos are not delivered
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 为什么视频没有传送

blocks.en: We read the records of all 224 runs that ended without a playable video and assigned each one main cause (Fig. 4 a).
blocks.zh: 我们阅读了所有224个运行的记录,这些运行结束时没有可播放的视频,并分配了每个主要原因(图4a)。

blocks.en: Finding 3. Videos are lost to time management, not to a short budget.
blocks.zh: 查找 3. 视频丢失于时间管理,而不是短期预算。

blocks.en:
Three quarters of the failures (169) are final renders that started too late, ran too slowly or never started; the rest are stalled renders (45, 20%), outputs the agent destroyed itself (7, 3%) and other causes (3). Time management. Agents polish components and previews and launch the full render last: GPT-5.6 Sol’s final full renders in failed runs start at a median of 9 minutes before the deadline, often with frame-by-frame browser capture that needs 5–35 minutes, and 65 runs never start a final render at all. Stalled renders occur only in the two Gemini systems: 33 renders deadlock because the agent’s script pipes frames into ffmpeg while never reading its error stream (one stopped at frame 7,744 of 10,102, about 90 s from completion), and in 12 runs the agent ended its turn while a render ran in the background, which was then cut off. Self-destruction is the most avoidable: DeepSeek verified its video twice, then re-encoded it in place one minute before the deadline and left a truncated 0.26 MB file.
The successful systems leave margin. Opus, the only system without a failure, finishes its video a median of 24 minutes before the deadline, against 10–11 minutes for Sol and GLM (Fig. 4 b); it first produces a complete deliverable, then improves only copies and verifies the encoded MP4 itself. A larger budget does not substitute for this: in a budget ablation (App. I.3 ), DeepSeek scores 3.92 with 60 minutes and 3.94 with 120, while using 35 more minutes.
blocks.zh:
四分之三的失败(169起)是最终造成的,开始太迟、运行太慢或从未开始;其余的则停滞不前(45%、20%)、输出物剂自毁(7%、3%)和其他原因(3)。 时间管理. Agents抛出组件和预览并推出最后的完整渲染:GPT-5.6 Sol的终极渲染完成后,在截止日期前9分钟的中位数开始失败运行,通常每个帧的浏览器抓取需要5-35分钟,而65跑则根本没有开始最终渲染. 安装只发生在两个双子星系统:33个系统由于代理商的脚本管框在从未读取其出错流时会陷入僵局(一个停止在10 102个框的7744个框上,大约90秒后完成),12个系统运行了代理商在背景中运行一个渲染器时结束其转弯,然后被切断了。 自毁是最可避免的:DeepSeek验证了它的视频两次,然后在截止日期前一分钟重新编码,并留下了截取的0.26 MB文件.
成功的系统留下了差幅。 Opus是唯一一个没有出故障的系统,在截止日期前完成中位数为24分钟的视频,而Sol和GLM(图4b)的视频为10-11分钟;它首先产生完整的可交付文件,然后只改进副本并验证被编码的MP4本身. 更大的预算不能取而代之:在预算膨胀(App. I.3.)中,DeepSeek以60分的成绩得分3.92分,以120分的成绩得分3.94分,同时使用多35分的成绩.

blocks.en: 5.3 How agents make videos
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 代理制作视频的方式

blocks.en: We analyze the 2,151 trajectories (tool calls, written files, commands) to characterize the process.
blocks.zh: 我们分析2,151个轨迹(工具调用,书面文件,命令)来描述这一过程.

blocks.en: Finding 4. Agents build their own renderers, each with a house style.
blocks.zh: 查找 4. 代理人自建出自制器,每出出一出有房屋风格.

blocks.en: The pipeline is always “code → \rightarrow frames → \rightarrow ffmpeg”: runs call ffmpeg in 96–100% of cases, whereas Manim appears in 8 of 2,151 runs and MoviePy in 13. Each system has a preferred rendering stack (Fig. 4 c): Claude agents draw vectors with cairo (46–54% of runs), GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi and GLM rasterize frames with PIL/numpy (43–55%), and Astra, DeepSeek and Gemini 3.8 Flash capture browser canvases and three.js scenes (52–60%). Soundtracks are programmed too: 57–96% of runs synthesize music or effects in code. Cairo and browser-2D runs pass the container-level check most often (88% and 85%) and score highest (3.79 and 3.73), three.js scenes least (78%, 3.00); since renderer and system are coupled, this is an association, consistent with slow frame capture being a main cause of late renders (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 输油管总是"代码 ~\正右框 ~\正右框 ffmpeg":在96-100%的案例中运行调用ffmpeg,而马尼姆出现在2,151跑中的8跑中,而电影Py出现在13跑中. 每个系统都有首选的渲染堆栈(图4 c): Claude代理以 Cairo (46–54%跑道),GPT-5.6 Sol,Kimi和GLM 来绘制矢量,用PIL/numpy (43–55%),以及Astra,DeepSeek和双子座 3.8 Flash捕捉浏览器帆布和3个.js场景(52–60%)来绘制帧. 音轨也被编程:57-96%的跑道在代码中合成了音乐或效果. 开罗和浏览器-2D运行最常通过容器级别检查(88%和85%),得分最高(3.79和3.73),3.j的场景最少(78%;3.00);由于渲染器和系统是相配的,这是一个关联,与慢帧捕捉是迟发的主要原因相一致(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: Finding 5. Self-inspection is universal but not decisive.
blocks.zh: 查找 5. 自我检查是普遍的,但不是决定性的。

blocks.en: 95% of runs view their own rendered frames, yet the amount of looking does not predict delivered quality ( ρ = − 0.07 \rho{=}{-}0.07 , n = 9 n{=}9 ; Fig. 4 d): Astra looks least (median 3 images per run) and scores best, while DeepSeek looks most (median 35). Reports often claim verifications that do not hold: among playable videos that fail spec compliance, the final report still claims the video was verified (“verified”, “ffprobe”, “confirmed”) in 10 of 14 for Astra and 3 of 11 for Sol.
blocks.zh: 95%的运行查看他们自己制作的相框,但查看的量并不预测交付的质量(^ ^ 0.07\rho{=}{-}0.07,n = 9 n{=}9;图4 d): Astra外观最小(每跑中3个图像)并得分最好,而DeepSeek外观最出名(中35个). 报告往往声称没有进行核查:在可播放的未遵守规格的视频中,最后报告仍然声称,在Astra14的10起和Sol11的3起中,录像得到了核实(“核实”、“ffprobe”、“确认”)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Judges and humans
blocks.zh: 5.4 法官和人类

blocks.en: Table 3 : Judge reliability on the 239 tasks. Top: agreement between judge panels (about 1,920 videos judged by each pair). Bottom: agreement with blind pairwise human preferences; Spearman between human Elo and the panel’s delivered-only overall ( n = 9 n{=}9 ), and agreement on human-decisive pairs the panel does not tie.
blocks.zh: 表3:239项任务的可靠性判断。 Top:法官小组之间达成协议(每对评出约1,920个视频). 最底层:与盲目对等的人类喜好达成协议; 人类埃罗与面板只交付的整体(n = 9 n{=}9)之间的斯皮尔曼(Spearman),

blocks.en: Finding 6. Judges and humans agree on systems, not on single videos.
blocks.zh: 查找 6. 法官和人类商定制度,而不是单行录相带。

blocks.en: The three panels rank systems almost identically (system-level Spearman 0.93 0.93 – 0.95 0.95 ), and the three-panel mean ranks them like humans do ( ρ = 0.98 \rho{=}0.98 with human Elo; Tab. 3 ). On single pairs the mean agrees with humans 73.3% of the time, but the agreement depends on the margin: 63% when the panels’ score gap is below 0.2 (about a third of pairs) and 86% when it is 0.5 or more. Judges also miss what humans flag: on pairs that annotators label both bad , the panels give the same scores (3.81) as on other pairs, so judge scores order videos but do not certify them as acceptable. The disagreements concentrate on two systems, in opposite directions: humans prefer GPT-5.6 Sol’s videos 16 points less often than the judges do, as the judges penalize it mainly on audio (AQ), and Gemini 3.8 Flash 11 points more often. Per video, check verdicts reach only κ = 0.44 \kappa{=}0.44 – 0.56 0.56 despite 91–95% raw agreement, overall scores correlate at r = 0.45 r{=}0.45 – 0.51 0.51 , and same-task orderings agree only 66–70% of the time. Panels also differ in strictness: J1 is stricter and J2 more lenient, especially on weaker systems, and strict success, which fails a task on a single failed check, is sensitive to this (Opus: 83.7%, 93.3% and 51.9% under J1–J3), so only the three-panel mean is comparable. Implication: current judges can certify system-level rankings over hundreds of tasks, but per-video verdicts—and per-video rewards for training—need margins, multi-panel consensus or human checks.
blocks.zh: 三个小组几乎完全相同(系统级Spearman 0.93 – 0.95 0.95 ) , 三个小组的平均级别与人类的Elo = 0.98\rho = 0.98; Tab. 3 ) 。 在一对小组中,平均级别与人类73.3%的时间一致,但协议取决于比值:63%的小组得分差距低于0.2(约三分之一的对数),而86%的小组则低于0.5。 评委们也怀念人类的旗帜:在标注者标出两种差的一对上, 分歧集中于两个系统,方向相反:人类更喜欢GPT-5.6 Sol的视频比法官少16分,因为法官主要在音频(AQ)上惩罚它,双子座 3.8 Flash 11分也多出. 每段视频,检查结果只达到0.44\kappa=0.44 — 0.56 0.56,尽管有91-95%的原始协议,总得分在0.45 r= 0.45 — 0.51 0.51,同一项任务订单只同意时间的66-70%。 J1更严格,J2更宽放,特别是在较弱的系统上,严格的成功 — — 一次失败的检查都失败了 — — 对这一点很敏感(Opus:83.7%、93.3%和51.9%在J1–J3下),因此只有三小组的平均值是可比的。 影响:现任法官可以证明系统级别在数百项任务上的排名,但每个视频的判决——以及每个视频对培训的奖励——需要幅度、多小组共识或人力检查。

blocks.en: 5.5 Cost
blocks.zh: 5.5 费用

blocks.en: Finding 7. Cost buys little quality.
blocks.zh: 查找 7. 成本价格低廉。

blocks.en: Mean list-price API cost per task spans 49 × 49\times across systems, from $0.32 (GLM-5.3-Flash) to $15.38 (Claude Opus 5.5), and systems spend it differently (Fig. 5 a): about three quarters of Opus’s cost goes to prompt-cache writes, whereas more than half of GPT-5.6 Sol’s goes to fresh, uncached input. Higher spending does not buy a matching score: the rank correlation between cost and the overall score is not significant ( ρ = 0.55 \rho{=}0.55 , p = 0.12 p{=}0.12 , n = 9 n{=}9 ), and score per dollar differs by more than 30 × 30\times , from 0.26 points per USD for Opus to 8.8 for GLM (Fig. 5 b). DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches 95% of GPT-6 Astra’s score at 5.8% of its cost. Spending is not effort either: Astra produces the fewest output tokens (61k per task, against 77k–289k for the others), and within every system longer runs score lower ( ρ \rho from − 0.22 {-}0.22 to − 0.69 {-}0.69 ), because long runs are runs in trouble. Costs are list-price equivalents of logged token usage (billing-verified for Claude); per-system details are in App. G .
blocks.zh: 平均价价价API成本跨系统从0.32美元(GLM-5.3-Flash)到15.38美元(Claude Opus 5.5)不等,系统花费不同(图5a):约四分之三的Opus成本用于即时缓冲写作,而超过半数的GPT-5.6 Sol投入新鲜而无节制的投入。 高支出不购买相匹配分数:成本与总分的分数关联不显著(^ 0.55\rho{=}0.55,p = 0.12 p{=}0.12,n = 9 n{=}9),而每美元得分相差超过30×30分,从Opus每美元0.26分到GLM每美元8.8分(图5b). DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash以5.8%的成本达到GPT-6 Astra的95%分数. 开支也不是努力: Astra生产出最少的输出符(每作61k,而其他的为77k–289k),在每一个较长的系统内,运行得分都较低(从−0.22 {}0.22到−0.69 {}0.69),因为长跑会遇到麻烦. 成本是所记录的象征性用途的列表价格等同物(Claude的账单-核实);每个系统的细节载于App.G.。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented VibeVideoBench, a benchmark of 239 realistic, checkable tasks on which multimodal agents must make complete audio-visual videos with code, evaluated by program checks, task-specific rubric checks and quality scores from three judge panels validated against blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as how good it is, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started; agents should secure a complete video early and verify the delivered file. Automatic judges agree with each other and with humans on how systems rank, but only moderately on single videos, so per-video verdicts still need margins, multi-panel consensus or human checks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VibeVideo Bench,这是239项现实可行的、可核查的任务的基准,多式联运代理商必须用代码制作完整的视听录像,通过程序检查、特定任务标题检查以及三个法官小组的质量评分来评价,这些评分是针对人类盲目的偏好。 跨越9个前沿代理系统,基准远未被解决:GPT-6 Astra和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5明显领先,然而即使是最好的系统也未能满足约四分之一任务的核心要求. 视频是否到达所有问题, 以及四分之三的已丢失视频是否最终完成, 自动裁判员彼此和人类都同意系统如何排列,但只适度地在单视频上,因此每个视频的判决仍然需要边际,多小组共识或人检查.

blocks.zh: A.1 源流和漏斗

blocks.zh: 表A.1:建筑漏斗。 每一阶段的计数;括号内为“固定”费率。

blocks.en: What was removed. Most web prompts failed because they presupposed material that was not provided (125 of 332 removals) or were content-free style templates (99); the rest were intros and logo stings (43), ambient loops without development (25), tasks that do not ask for a finished video (19) and duplicates (15). W0150 was removed after the rollouts because it requires two tools whose licenses exclude use in an evaluation harness, so it cannot be done as written.
blocks.zh: 被移除的东西。 大部分的网络提示失败了,因为它们预先假定了没有提供的材料(332个删除的125个)或者是无内容样式模板(99个);其余的则是介绍和标志刺痕(43个),环境环路没有开发(25个),任务不需要完成的视频(19个)和重复(15个). W0150在推出后被移除,因为它需要两种工具,其许可证排除了在评估工具中的使用,因此不能按书面方式使用。

blocks.en: Selection. Human selectors preferred checkable tasks: they kept 88% of the music and sound-driven drafts and about half of the explainers, but only 17% of the story and comedy drafts and 15% of the game drafts. Two LLM screens, which graded every candidate highly, therefore remain a weak proxy for human judgments of task value.
blocks.zh: 选取. 人类选手偏好可核查的任务:他们保留了88%的音乐和由声音驱动的草稿,以及大约一半的解释者,但只有17%的故事和喜剧草稿以及15%的游戏草稿. 两个LLM屏幕将每个候选人评分很高,因此仍然是对任务价值的人类判断的弱代表。

blocks.en: Pilot-selected tasks. The ten pilot-selected tasks could widen the gaps between systems. Removing them barely changes the leaderboard (no video = 0 =0 ): the only change is that Gemini 3.8 Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash, which are statistically tied (App. E ), swap the last two places (Kendall τ = 0.94 \tau{=}0.94 ), and the spread between the best and worst system goes from 1.32 to 1.30 points.
blocks.zh: 试点选取任务. 10项试点任务可以扩大各系统之间的差距。 删除它们几乎不改变导板(没有视频=0=0):唯一的改变是双子座3.8 Flash和GLM-5.3-Flash,它们有统计绑定(App. E),将后两个位置相换(Kendell \ = 0.94\ tau\ 0.94),最佳和最差的系统之间的分布从1.32到1.30分.

blocks.en: Authoring. LLM drafters with cross-review recorded for every task its source, the selected time range and everything added at authoring time (facts, lines, durations, assets, structure). An automated audit found that 336 of the 397 drafts leaked process information (reviewer notes, internal review status, scoring hints) into the prompt; the final rewrite removed it with all input files hash-verified unchanged. We note this as a general hazard of LLM-assisted benchmark construction.
blocks.zh: 写作中. LLM 起草器对每个任务的源头,选定的时间范围以及作者时间所添加的一切(事实,行,持续时间,资产,结构)进行交叉审查记录. 一项自动化审计发现,397个草稿中有336个将流程信息(审查员说明,内部审查状况,评分提示)泄露入了快报;最后的重写将其删除,所有输入文件的hash-验证不变. 我们注意到,这是LLM援助基准建设的一个普遍危险。

blocks.en: A.2 Taxonomy
blocks.zh: A.2 分类学

blocks.en: B.1 Structure of a rubric
blocks.zh: B.1 标题的结构

blocks.en: A rubric file holds a task profile (purpose, audience, allowed presentations, evidence types, not-applicable boundaries), the core goals , the task checks (L2), a requirement coverage map from every prompt requirement to its checks, an evidence policy and the task’s quality rubric (L3). Each check has an ID, a title, a goal, a criticality, pass, fail and unknown conditions, an observation scope, the required evidence (time codes), verbatim basis quotes from the prompt, allowed variations and a modality tag (Tab. B.1 ). Over the 239 tasks there are 12,985 checks (54.3 per task, 13–110); 85.8% are core , the rest detail ( supporting for lessons and papers). Unknown is reserved for insufficient evidence: “confirmed omissions or violations in the complete work are a fail and must not be concealed with unknown”.
blocks.zh: 标题文件包含一个任务简介(目的、受众、允许的演示、证据类型、不适用的界限)、核心目标、任务检查(L2)、从每个即时要求到检查的要求覆盖图、证据政策和任务的质量标题(L3)。 每张支票都有一个ID,一个标题,一个目标,一个临界度,通过,失败和未知的条件,一个观察范围,所需的证据(时间代码),从提示中逐字引用,允许的变换和模式标记(Tab.B.1. 在239项任务中,有12 985项检查(每项任务54.3项,13-110项);85.8%为核心,其余细节(支持经验教训和论文)。 由于证据不足而保留了未知证据:“经证实的遗漏或整个工作中的违规行为是失败的,不得以未知方式隐瞒”。

blocks.en: Quality rubric. The five L3 dimensions share 20 observation points: VQ1 key-content legibility, VQ2 stability, VQ3 occlusion/cropping/layering, VQ4 object consistency; VA1 hierarchy, VA2 composition, VA3 unity of visual language, VA4 audience fit; CL1 organization, CL2 key relations, CL3 information load, CL4 channel coordination; TM1 action, TM2 state change and transitions, TM3 dwell on key content, TM4 overall rhythm; AQ1 intelligibility and pronunciation, AQ2 prosody, AQ3 mixing, AQ4 sound–event alignment. Each dimension has task-specific anchors at 1, 3 and 5 ( e.g . , VQ for CG01: 1 = “key content remains unclear or is disrupted by visual defects”, 5 = “key content clear, image stable, details support viewing”); a 2 or 4 must say which anchor it is closer to, and insufficient evidence yields unknown , never a default 3. Intentional pixel-art style, grain or blur is not a defect.
blocks.zh: 质量主题. 5个L3维共有20个观测点: VQ1 密钥-内容可分辨性, VQ2 稳定性, VQ3 隐含/剪接/上层, VQ4 对象一致性; VA1 分级, VA2 组成, VA3 视觉语言的统一, VA4 受众适合; CL1 组织, CL2 关键关系, CL3 信息载荷, CL4 通道协调; TM1 动作, TM2 状态变化和过渡, TM3 沉淀关键内容, TM4 整体节奏; AQ1 隐含和发音, AQ2 亲音, AQ3 混合, AQ4 音-event 相接. 每个维度在1,3和5有特定任务主锚(例如,CG01的VQ:1 = “关键内容仍然不明确或因视觉缺陷而中断”,5 = “关键内容清晰、图像稳定、细节支持查看”); 2 或 4 必须说明它更接近哪个主锚,不充分的证据产生未知结果,绝不是默认 3. 有意的像素艺术风格、谷物或模糊不是缺陷。

blocks.en: B.2 Authoring principles
blocks.zh: B.2 授权原则

blocks.en: Every check quotes the prompt sentence it enforces, and optional language (“may”, “e.g.”) never becomes mandatory ( traceability ). A correct final number or a caption reading “synced” cannot pass a check that requires a visible process ( process over claims ): in a marble adder the sum must be produced by actual contacts. Core and detail are fixed before any output is seen, so cosmetic passes cannot outvote a failed core goal. Timing thresholds state how to measure them under frame sampling: “at least N N seconds” passes only if the lower bound is ≥ N {\geq}N , fails if the upper bound is < N {<}N , and is otherwise unknown. 40–50 checks is a coverage aim, not a quota, and no check may prescribe a production method (45 early “must use CSS”-style checks were deleted).
blocks.zh: 每张支票都引用其所执行的即时句子,可选语言(“可以”,“例如”)永远不会成为强制性(可追溯性)。 一个正确的最后编号或标题读作“synessd”不能通过一个需要明显过程的检查(处理索赔的过程):在大理石外加器中,金额必须用实际接触来产生。 在看到任何产出之前,核心和细节是固定的,因此化妆品通行证不能超过一个失败的核心目标。 计时阈值说明如何在框架取样中测量它们:“至少N秒”只有在下限为 Q = N = 克克时才通过。 N,如果上方绑定值为 < N QQN ,则失败,否则未知。 40-50次检查是一个覆盖目标,而不是配额,任何检查都不得规定一种生产方法(45次早期的“必须使用CSS”式检查被删除)。

blocks.en: B.3 Rubrics for lessons and papers
blocks.zh: B.3 经验教训和论文的Rubrics

blocks.en: The 34 lessons and papers (C11, C12) use the same levels and judge interface, but their checks come from the supplied material. L1 adds narration coverage (VAD speech share ≥ 50 % {\geq}50\% , no gap over 20 s), narration language (ASR, ≥ 90 % {\geq}90\% in the target language) and no long black or frozen stretch. L2 has 48–83 checks per task (2,172 in total; 1,566 core): content checks enumerate the knowledge points (each concept, derivation step, worked answer, common misconception and relation to be drawn; for papers the motivation, key idea, method components, key equations, results, evidence and limitations), and narration checks require correct reading of terms, formulas and numbers, explanation rather than reading on-screen text aloud, and synchronization at 4–6 key moments. Because judges never see the note or the paper, 330 checks that referred to them (“consistent with the note”) were rewritten to state the required content, and six audit agents re-derived every number and formula against the source. Each task also has a grounded quiz (404 questions), reported separately (App. I.2 ).
blocks.zh: 34个课程和论文(C11,C12)使用相同的水平和判断界面,但其检查来自所提供的材料. L1添加了叙事覆盖(VAD语音分享了~~50% ~geq}~50\%,没有间隙超过20 s),叙事语言(ASR,~90% ~geq}~90\%在目标语言中),没有长的黑色或被冻结的拉伸. L2每个任务(共计2,172个;1,566个核心)有48-83个检查:内容检查列举了知识点(每个概念、衍生步骤、有效的答案、共同的误解和需要绘制的关系;对于论文,动机、关键思想、方法组成部分、关键方程、结果、证据和限制)和叙述检查要求正确解读术语、公式和数字、解释而不是在屏幕上大声读取文本,并在4-6个关键时刻同步。 由于法官从未看到该说明或文件,因此重写了330份提到这些说明(“与说明一致”)的检查,以说明所要求的内容,6名审计人员重新提出每个数字和公式,以反驳来源。 每项任务还有一个有根据的测验(404个问题),分别报告(App.I.2.)。

blocks.en: B.4 Quality control
blocks.zh: B.4 质量控制

blocks.en: Rubrics were refined over many rounds in a closed loop. In each round an independent model reviewed every rubric against its prompt, each finding was re-adjudicated in a fresh context and verified by a human reviewer, confirmed findings were fixed, and the revised rubrics re-entered review until no confirmed finding remained. The most frequent defect was over-specification (a rubric demanding more than the prompt), ahead of coverage gaps; the review also surfaced bugs in the tasks themselves, such as an infeasible inventory or contradictory timing tables, which were fixed in the prompts.
blocks.zh: Rubrics在密闭循环中经过多轮改进而成. 每轮均有一个独立模型对照其即时审查每个标题,每个结论在新的背景下重新裁定,并由人文审查者核实,确认结论被固定,修改后的标题重新入评,直到没有确认结论为止。 最常见的缺陷是超规格(比快要求更高),领先于覆盖漏洞;审查中也浮出任务本身的bug,如不可行的清点表或自相矛盾的时间表,这些表格被固定在提示中.

blocks.en: B.5 Modality tags
blocks.zh: B.5 模式标签

blocks.en: Each check is tagged with the evidence needed to decide it: visual 9,006 (69.4%), audio-visual 3,012 (23.2%) and audio 967 (7.4%). The tags route checks in J3 (App. D ) and define the modality breakdown of App. E .
blocks.zh: 每张支票上贴有决定它所需的证据:视觉9 006 (69.4%)、视听3 012 (23.2%)和音频967 (7.4%)。 标签在J3(App. D)中检查路由,并定义App. E.

blocks.en: Appendix D Judge Protocol and Judge Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 法官礼宾和法官分析

blocks.en: D.1 Protocol
blocks.zh: D.1 议定书

blocks.en: Each judge receives the prompt the agent received, the task checks and the quality rubric, but never the system identity, the source code or the agent’s notes. For every check it returns pass, fail, unknown or n/a with the time range and the channel (picture or sound) that support the verdict, and it scores the five quality dimensions against the task’s anchors with reasons. On-screen or narrated claims (“✓ requirement met”) are not evidence, properties of the delivered file are left to the program checks, a judge that sees sampled frames may not assert what happens between them, and insufficient evidence yields unknown.
blocks.zh: 每位法官都收到代理人收到的提示、任务检查和质量说明,但从未收到系统身份、源代码或代理人的笔记。 每一次检查都会通过、失败、未知或n/a,并有时间范围和支持判断的通道(图片或声音),它会根据任务的主播对五个质量维度进行评分。 屏幕上或叙述性索赔(“满足要求”)不是证据,交付文件的属性留给程序检查,看到抽样框架的法官可能不断言它们之间发生的情况,而且证据不足。

blocks.en: Panels differ in strictness, especially on weak systems. J1 is the harshest on L3 ( − - 0.41 against the other two panels) and the most discriminative (spread 0.89 on delivered videos). J2 is lenient and compressed: 70% of its dimension scores are a 4 and its delivered-only spread is 0.46. J3 is the harshest on checks (L2 88.2%; it also leaves 6.3% unknown) but the most generous on VA and AQ ( + + 0.46 and + + 0.61 against the other two). Leniency is not uniform: J1 is harsher on the weaker systems (GPT-5.6 Sol − - 0.67, Gemini 3.8 Flash − - 0.59, against − - 0.24 for Astra and Opus), and J2 and J3 are more lenient on them (J2: Sol + + 0.35, Flash + + 0.31, Astra − - 0.02). blocks.en: D.4 Self-preference

blocks.en: Three panels are run by models that are also evaluated as agents: J1 is Gemini 4 Argon, J2 is Gemini 3.8 Flash, and J3’s vision judge is GPT-5.6 Sol. On the 1,886 videos that all panels scored on the four visual dimensions (VQ, VA, CL, TM; for J3 these come from GPT-5.6 Sol alone), we compute each panel’s score minus its mean over all videos and subtract the same centered score averaged over the other two panels. The mean of this relative score per (panel, system) measures how much more a panel likes a system than the other panels do (Tab. D.2 ; 2,000-sample bootstrap over videos).
blocks.zh: 3个面板由模型管理,这些模型也被评价为代理人: J1是双子座4 Argon,J2是双子座3.8 Flash,而J3的视觉裁判是GPT-5.6 Sol. 所有板块在四个视觉维度(VQ、VA、CL、TM等)上打出1 886个视频, J3的这些视频仅出自GPT-5.6 Sol), 我们计算每个板块的得分减去它在所有视频上的平均值, 并减去其他两个板块的同一个中点得分平均值。 这个相对分数的平均值是每张(平面,系统)衡量一个面板比其他面板更喜欢一个系统(Tab. D.2;2000-sample boolstrap over video).

blocks.en: Two of three judges favor their own model, by about a sixth of a point. J2 rates the Gemini 3.8 Flash agent + + 0.16 and J3’s vision judge rates the GPT-5.6 Sol agent + + 0.20 higher than the other panels do; both intervals exclude zero. J1 shows no preference for the Gemini 4 Argon agent ( + + 0.03) and rates the Gemini family lower than the other panels ( − - 0.12). Panels also have tastes of similar size that have nothing to do with themselves: J1 favors the Claude agents and Astra ( + + 0.17 to + + 0.21) and disfavors Sol ( − - 0.32), and J2 disfavors Astra ( − - 0.23) while being lenient on the weaker systems (GLM + + 0.13, Sol + + 0.12), so part of its + + 0.16 for Flash is its general leniency toward weaker systems.
blocks.zh: 三位评委中有两位赞成他们自己的模式,大约是六分之一. J2对双子座 3.8 Flash 剂 + + 0.16 和 J3 的视觉判断器进行比其他面板高的GPT-5.6 Sol 剂 + + 0.20 的评分;两个间隔均排除了0. blocks.en: The ranking does not depend on it. Scoring each system without the panel that is its own model (J1 for Argon, J2 for Flash, J3 for Sol) changes only the last two places: Flash and GLM, 0.008 apart and statistically tied, swap (Kendall τ = 0.94 \tau{=}0.94 with the headline ranking). Scoring each system only with panels outside its family (the Gemini agents by J3 alone, the GPT agents by J1 and J2), after shifting every panel by its leniency offset on the commonly judged videos ( − - 0.27, + + 0.13 and + + 0.14 against the three-panel mean), leaves the order unchanged ( τ = 1 \tau{=}1 ): the Astra–Opus gap narrows from 0.034 to 0.018 (paired bootstrap P ⁡ ( Astra > Opus ) = 0.74 P(\text{Astra}{>}\text{Opus}){=}0.74 ), and Sol stays above Argon ( P = 0.95 P{=}0.95 ). Without the shift Opus overtakes Astra, but only because the panel dropped for the GPT agents (J3) is a lenient one. A relative score cannot separate a panel’s self-preference from the other panels’ dislike of the same system; only a check-level human calibration could say which panel is right.
blocks.zh: 排名不取决于此. 对每个系统进行校正,没有作为其自己的模型的面板(Argon为J1,Flash为J2,Sol为J3)只改变后两个位置: Flash和GLM,相差0.08分并按统计进行平分,互换(Kendall \ = 0.94\ tau\ 0.94以头条排名). 每个系统只用外侧的面板来涂分(仅J3的双子体特效,J1和J2的GPT特效),在将每个面板的宽大度抵消于通常判断的视频(--0.27,+ + 0.13和+ + 0.14取而代之于三平面取而代之)之后,令顺序不变(\\=1\tau\ 1): Astra – Opus 中的差距从 0.034 缩小到 0.018 ( paired pirtrap P → (Astra > Opus ) = 0.74 P (\text{Astra}{>}\text{Opus})), Sol 则停留在 Argon (P = 0.95 P{=}0.95) 上方。 没有转会 Opus 占据了 Astra, 但仅仅是因为板 掉为GPT 代理(J3)是一个宽大。 相对分数不能将小组的自我偏好与其他小组不喜欢同一系统区分开来;只有检查级的人类校正才能说出哪个小组是正确的。

blocks.en: Strong systems finish with time to spare. Opus and Astra usually end well before the hour, while GPT-5.6 Sol and GLM often run into the deadline; Sol has usually saved a playable video by then, GLM often has not. Within every system longer runs score lower: long runs are runs in trouble. The harnesses shape how agents work: Claude Code and Codex agents act almost entirely through the shell, Gemini, Kimi and GLM rely more on dedicated file tools, and Gemini 3.8 Flash spends much of its time waiting on background tasks. Sub-agents and web search are rarely used; installing packages is common.

blocks.en: Cost buys little quality. The mean list-price API cost per task spans 49 × 49\times across systems, from $0.32 (GLM) to $15.38 (Opus), but its rank correlation with the headline score is not significant ( ρ = 0.55 \rho{=}0.55 , permutation p = 0.13 p{=}0.13 , n = 9 n{=}9 ; 0.43 with the delivered-only score). DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches 95% of Astra’s score at 5.8% of its cost, and DeepSeek and GLM obtain 8.3–8.8 points of overall per dollar, about seven times the next system (Fig. 5 ). Spending is not effort either: Astra produces the fewest output tokens (61k per task, against 77k–289k for the others). The Pareto frontier (lowest cost, highest overall) is GLM → \rightarrow DeepSeek → \rightarrow Astra.

blocks.en: Appendix H Human Preference Study
blocks.zh: 附录H 人类优先研究

blocks.en: Protocol. Annotators compare two videos made by two systems for the same task. Both videos are playable and judged by all three panels, so the study measures the quality of delivered videos, not delivery. System pairs are balanced across tasks and the sides are randomized; annotators are blind to system identity and judge scores. The interface shows the full prompt and two synchronized players with a choice of audio track, and offers A better , B better , tie and both bad ; the instruction is “which better matches the prompt and is better overall”. We fit Bradley–Terry strengths on decisive votes (MM algorithm with a weak prior; Elo scale with geometric mean 1000), with 2,000-sample bootstrap CIs over decisive pairs and Wilson intervals for win rates.
blocks.zh: 议定书。 注释者比较两个系统为同一任务制作的两段视频. 两段视频都可以播放,并由所有三个板块评出,因此研究量度送出视频的质量,而不是送出. 系统对子在任务之间是平衡的,而侧面是随机的;注释者对系统身份视而不见并判断分数. 界面显示完全的即时和两个同步的玩家,选择了音频音轨,并提供了更好、更好、更好的B、领带和坏两个音轨;指示是“更好地与即时和整体匹配”。 我们把布拉德利-特里的优势放在决定性的选票上(MM算法前作弱;以几何平均值为1000的Elo比例),在决定性的一对上加2000-样本的靴子圈CI和威尔逊的取胜率间隔.

blocks.en: Four ablations check the evaluation and the rollout setting. The first two ask whether the scores can be trusted: can the judges see defects (§ I.1 ), and do the scores reflect whether a video actually teaches (§ I.2 )? The last two ask whether the setting limited the results: was one hour enough (§ I.3 ), and did the agents need more CPU cores (§ I.4 )? Each was run once per cell, after the main evaluation.

blocks.en: I.1 Judge stress test
blocks.zh: I.1 法官压力测试

blocks.en: We took 30 delivered videos, re-encoded each one cleanly and built ten defective versions with ffmpeg: five picture defects in the window from 35% to 65% of the runtime (black frames, a grey box over the center, heavy blur, a frozen picture) or over the whole video (left–right mirror), two sound defects (a silent window, another task’s soundtrack), audio delayed by 0.5 or 1.5 s, and the two halves swapped. Apart from the black window, every defective version passes all program checks, so only a judge can notice it. J1 judged each video in its clean version and in five of the defects (15 videos per defect, 180 judgments) with the unchanged prompt and rubric, and was not told that anything was injected.
blocks.zh: 我们拍摄了30个传送的视频,将每个视频重新重新编码,并用ffmpeg建造了10个有缺陷的版本:窗口中5个图片缺陷,从运行时间的35%到65%不等(黑框,中央上方有一灰盒,很模糊,被冻结)或整个视频(左-右镜),两个声音缺陷(一个静音窗口,另一个任务音轨),音频延迟了0.5秒或1.5秒,两个半相换. 除了黑窗外,每个有缺陷的版本都会通过所有程序检查,所以只有法官才能注意到. J1以干净的版本和五个缺陷(每个缺陷15个视频,180个判断)来判断每段视频,其提示和标题不变,没有被告知注入了任何东西.

blocks.en: Figure I.1 : Judge stress test (J1; 15 videos per defect). Left: share of reports that name the defect (checked by hand). Right: change of the most related L3 dimension against the clean re-encode of the same video (95% bootstrap CI).
blocks.zh: 图一.1:法官压力测试(J1;每个缺陷15个视频)。 左:指名缺陷的报告份额(由手检查). 右:将最相关的L3维与同段视频的清洁再编码(95%的靴子CI)相接而来.

blocks.en: Judges see broken pictures but not late sound (Fig. I.1 ). Every picture defect, the foreign soundtrack and the swapped halves are named in all 15 reports and cost 1.5–1.9 points on the related dimension; a silent window is named in 7 of 15 ( − - 0.80 on AQ). Neither audio delay is mentioned in any report, and reports often praise the synchronization; the five-dimension mean drops only slightly ( − - 0.11 and − - 0.16; Wilcoxon p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 and 0.05), spread over several dimensions rather than AQ. Detection does not always reach the checks: mirrored and reordered videos are named in every report, yet most of their target checks still pass (flip rate + + 4.5 and + + 14.9 points over clean), and the penalty lands on VQ and CL instead. Finally, the clean re-encode scores + + 0.12 [ + + 0.03, + + 0.22] above the original judgment of the same video, so gaps of 0.1–0.2 between single videos or close systems are within judge noise. Audio-visual timing is thus a blind spot of both the judges and the program checks.
blocks.zh: 法官看到相片被打碎,但声音不晚(图一.1)。 每个相片缺陷,外音轨和相换的半相片在所有15份报告中被命名,在相关维度上成本为1.5–1.9分;一个静音窗口被命名为15分之7(---0.80在AQ上). 任何报告都没有提到音频延迟,报告经常称赞同步;五分音值的表示只略微下降(−-0.11和−-0.16;Wilcoxon p = 0.07 p{=}0.07和0.05),分布在多个维度上而不是AQ. 侦测并非总能到达检查点:每份报告中都会标出镜像和重排的相片,然而其大多数目标检查仍能通过(比清取出分率+4.5和+14.9分),而罚取地为VQ和CL. 最后,干净的再编码分数++0.12 [++0.03,+++0.22]高于同一视频的最初判断,因此单视频或相近系统之间的0.1–0.2差距在法官噪声之内. 因此,视听时间是法官和程序检查的盲点。

blocks.en: I.2 Do the videos teach? A grounded quiz
blocks.zh: 一. 导言 视频会教吗? 被禁试

blocks.en: Each of the 34 lessons and papers has a multiple-choice quiz written from its source material (404 questions). A grader (Gemini 4 Argon) watches only the finished video and answers A–D or E (“the video does not cover it”). Every A–D answer must give a timestamp and the video’s own words; narration quotes are matched against a Whisper transcript and on-screen quotes against the frames, and an answer whose evidence does not check out counts as E. A task’s score is its share of correct answers; a run without a video scores 0. The quiz does not enter the leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 34个课程和论文中的每一个都有一个取自其原始资料的多选择考试(404个问题)。 一个分级员(Gemini 4 Argon)只看完好的视频并回答A-D或E(“视频没有覆盖它”). 每个A-D的回答必须给出一个时间戳和视频本身的话;叙述引文与Whisper的笔录和屏幕上对框的引文相匹配,以及一个其证据不确认为E的回答. 任务得分是正确答案的份额;没有视频得分的运行 0. 试题不入领跑板.

blocks.en: Figure I.2 : Grounded quiz on the 34 lessons and papers: share of questions answered correctly (mean over tasks) vs. the three-panel overall on the same tasks (no video = 0 =0 ).
blocks.zh: 图一.2:34个经验教训和论文的试题:问题得到正确回答的比例(平均高于任务)与关于相同任务的总体三组问题的比例(没有视频=0=0)。

blocks.en: The quiz agrees with the judges. Although it uses neither the rubric nor the quality anchors, its system ranking correlates with the three-panel overall at Spearman ρ = 0.93 \rho{=}0.93 (Fig. I.2 ; also 0.93 on playable videos only). The top four systems convey 93–96% of the tested points; Gemini 4 Argon’s 77.4% comes from its five tasks without a playable video (90.8% on the other 29). Almost no point is lost to a wrong answer (2 of 3,425 A–D answers); the losses are questions the video does not cover or whose evidence does not check out, so the quiz measures coverage of the material more than correctness. Agreement on single runs is only moderate ( ρ = 0.32 \rho{=}0.32 over the 299 playable runs), and the quiz separates the top systems poorly (93.4–95.6%).
blocks.zh: 考证同意评委的意见. 虽然它既不使用标题,也不使用质量主播,但其系统排名与Spearman ^ = 0.93\rho\0.93(图一.2;仅可播放的视频上也有0.93)的三组整体相关. 前4个系统传递了93-96%的测试点;双子座4 Argon的77.4%来自它的5个任务,没有播放视频(另外29个是90.8%)。 几乎没有错答(3,425个A-D回答中的2个)而失去任何意义;损失是视频没有覆盖或其证据没有检查出来的问题,因此,测试测量材料的覆盖范围比正确性还要多. 单跑协议只有中度(与299个可玩跑相比为0.32\rho 0.32),而考试则将顶级系统分开(93.4-95.6%)。

blocks.zh: 一.3. 时间预算

blocks.en: We reran DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 20 tasks with budgets of 15, 30, 60 and 120 minutes (one run per cell, otherwise as in the main evaluation). Runs are judged by J2 with no video = 0 =0 and compared with the 60-minute arm by a paired Wilcoxon test.

blocks.en: Quality saturates between 30 and 60 minutes (Fig. I.3 ). Only the 15-minute budget loses videos (4 of 20 without a playable video, 13 runs cut at the deadline; − - 1.03 against 60 minutes, p = 0.006 p{=}0.006 ), and even its delivered videos are worse (3.61 vs. 3.92). From 30 minutes on every run delivers, and doubling the budget from 60 to 120 minutes adds 0.01 ( p = 0.78 p{=}0.78 ) while the agent uses 34 more minutes (median 47 vs. 81). For this system, non-delivery in the main evaluation is therefore not caused by a short budget but by how the run uses it (§ 5.2 ). Limitations : one system, one run per cell, and J2’s compressed scale (App. D ).

blocks.en: More cores do not measurably help (Fig. I.4 ). None of the pooled differences is significant ( + + 0.09 for 8 vs. 2 cores, + + 0.13 for 16 vs. 8, + + 0.22 for 16 vs. 2; p = 0.57 p{=}0.57 , 0.44, 0.20; a bootstrap over tasks gives the same conclusion), and playable videos go from 99 to 101 and 103 of 120 (sign tests p ≥ 0.56 p{\geq}0.56 ). blocks.en: Appendix J Limitations and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录J 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Limitations (expanded). • Single run per task. The CIs cover task sampling only; system-level means are stable, but single outcomes vary from run to run, so per-task scores should not be over-read. • Fixed budget. Every run gets one hour and a single attempt, which may not let an agent reach the best video it could make with more time, compute or iterations. The time-budget ablation finds saturation within an hour for one system (App. I.3 ), which need not hold for every system or for the longest tasks. • Adherence over creativity. The rubrics mainly measure whether a video follows its specification. Creativity and originality enter only partly, through the aesthetics dimension (VA), and are not evaluated on their own. • Judge dependence. All panels are proprietary models, and the judges are insensitive to audio-visual timing (App. I.1 ). Rankings are stable across three panels from different families, but absolute values are panel-specific and are never mixed. • Coverage. The task set leans toward explainers (C04, C11 and C12 hold 38% of the tasks), is mostly English (209 of 239) and limited to 1080p-class outputs. Tasks with very long runtimes are few.
blocks.zh: 限制(扩大)。 • 每项任务单跑。 CI只覆盖任务采样;系统级手段稳定,但单个结果因运行而异,因此每个任务分数不应被超读. • 固定预算。 每次运行都得到一个小时和一次尝试,这也许不会让代理到达它用更多时间,计算或迭代所能制作的最佳视频. 时间预算缩减发现一个系统在一小时内饱和(App.I.3),因为每个系统或最长的任务都不需要满足。 • 坚持创造性。 标题主要衡量视频是否遵循其规格. 创意和原创性仅通过美学维度(VA)部分进入,不单独评价. • 法官依赖性。 所有分庭都是专有模式,法官对视听时间不敏感(App.I.1)。 排名在来自不同家庭的三个面板上是稳定的,但绝对值是面板特异性的,从不混合. • 覆盖范围。 设定的任务倾向于解释器(C04,C11和C12占据了38%的任务),大部分是英语(239个中的209个)并限于1080p级输出. 长期任务很少。

blocks.en: Broader impact. Code-driven video makes precise, editable and accessible content (lessons, data stories, instructions) cheaper to produce, and our findings point to concrete reliability improvements. Risks include persuasive marketing content and misinformation rendered with an appearance of precision. Tasks with factual content ship their facts as inputs and forbid fabricated claims ( e.g . , “do not claim a real interception probability”). No task depicts real private individuals. Classic-game tasks use newly designed levels and assets in a recognizable style for research evaluation; we will not redistribute original game assets.
blocks.zh: 更大的影响。 由代码驱动的视频使得制作的准确,可编辑和可获取的内容(经验教训,数据故事,说明)更便宜,我们的调查结果指出了具体的可靠性改进. 风险包括有说服力的营销内容和表面上准确的错误信息。 带有事实内容的任务将事实作为投入载运,并禁止捏造的主张(例如,“不声称有真正的拦截概率”)。 没有任务描绘出真正的个人。 经典游戏任务将新设计的关卡和资产以可识别的风格用于研究评价;我们不会重新分配原始游戏资产.
